title: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
lede: SuperTranslator combines a dog's posture, sounds and surroundings into one reading, then offers a plain-English guess at what the animal is trying to say.

points: Instead of mapping single barks to stock phrases, it weighs several behavioral cues at the same moment.
Inputs are body language, vocalizations and how the dog is reacting to what is around it.
The launch comment says the team spent 11 years on it, drew on 100,000 scientific studies and brought in a Stanford linguistics professor.
The team calls the current translation very basic, while citing its own benchmarks for a best-ever accuracy claim.
No method for checking the output is described; one commenter asked exactly how precision could be validated.

sections.text: Dog owners curious about their pet's mood; the launch comment pitches it to anyone who loves pets and wants to give theirs a voice.
